ticket: I1 step 3 - m20 row-slice merge byte-identical under the APPROVED dtop format change (option B)
verdict: LANDED on the 100 MB anchor: two halves cut where the 8-byte context changes merge into a member BYTE-IDENTICAL to the single pass in every column, dtop included. The member bytes changed, so the 100 MB anchor pin and both generated-v10 fixture pins move. Previous receipt 100m-m20slice.json is not edited: it records the state before the decision.
decision: Operator-approved 2026-11-27: dtop stops being a Misra-Gries candidate and becomes order-independent. A node that has not overflowed DOC_SMALL keeps its exact set and dtop = the SMALLEST id in it; a node that has overflowed stores no candidate and dtop = 0. Merge: exact+exact = union in first-appearance order with dtop = smallest id; if either side overflowed the result overflows and dtop = 0. Exactly mergeable because min(A u B) = min(min A, min B). The two MG counters left DocAcc and the per-node accumulator record; the HLL registers, n, over and the exact list stay. ndocs/HLL still answers "how many documents".
implemented: xsa/src/ctx.rs: DocAcc drops mg/mgc; DocAcc::dtop replaces DocAcc::heavy (smallest exact id, 0 once over); doc_summary emits it; merge_docs loses the summed-counter block (the merged dtop is read off the merged accumulator); the accumulator record is 104 B (8 x u32 exact list, n, over, 64 HLL registers) instead of 128 and the partial magic is XSLICE02 so an old partial is refused rather than misread; the reader's Trie::docs reports no candidate for an estimator node (it used to report the MG estimate). xsa/src/build_pfp.rs unchanged. gates/pfp_ctx_slice_test.py: accepts XSLICE02. gates/pfp_generated_v10_test.py: both pins re-pinned, with the format change named as the cause.

open_risks: The stored dtop for an ESTIMATOR node is 0, and doc id 0 is a legal id: only flags bit1 (exact list vs HLL) separates them. Trie::docs therefore reports no candidate for estimator nodes; a reader that reads the dtop column directly must check bit1 first.

TRIE_VERSION (the member head layout) is unchanged at 3: the head layout did not move, only one column's meaning did, so members built before this change still open and still answer, with their old M-G values in dtop (now not surfaced for estimator nodes). Nothing records which dtop semantics a container was built with - if that matters, it needs a version field.
Only two adjacent ranges can be merged today: a middle group still cannot emit a partial, so the K-range assembler is still open (unchanged by this ticket).

The half-range partial is still 3.18 GB for 27.96 M retained nodes because every node carries the 64-byte HLL file; keeping registers only for overflowed nodes is the next trim and is not in this ticket.
